# La Clinique Swiss

> A 30-year renewable longevity membership to a longevity clinic hotel on Karimunjawa, "the Maldives of Indonesia", with a Swiss medical director on the team. €3,500 in one single payment, VAT included, for 30 years, renewable, for up to 2 people.

## The offer
- Price: €3,500, one single payment, VAT included. No deposit, no instalments. Nothing is charged before the member signs the membership terms.
- Duration: 30 years (2027 to 2056), renewable. Inheritable within that period. Transferable to another member from the same country at the price paid, when there is a buyer.
- Each year: six nights in a private cabin for up to 2 people. Housekeeping €150 per stay. Nothing is paid in years the member does not come.
- Health: a core panel every year and up to 31 health markers on a schedule set by a physician (heart, metabolism, inflammation, hormones, organs, body and recovery). A personal dietitian and coach online from 2027.
- Places: 100 members per country.
- Next residences are planned in Europe and Latin America; members get nights there subject to availability and to the membership terms.
- It is not an investment and promises no return. It does not guarantee medical outcomes.

## Location
- Site: about 40,000 m² on the west coast of Kemujan, Karimunjawa islands, Central Java, Indonesia (5°47′ S, 110°28′ E), a few minutes from Dewadaru airstrip.
- Getting there: fly to Semarang, about two hours by car to Jepara, then about two hours by fast boat.
